about: Get an electronic ICP card for a company or government entity showing its registered data.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Valid Emirates ID of one authorised signatory, or a Unified Number for visitors
Free zone companies apply through their free zone authority
Government entities need the decree or law that set them up
documents: Government: establishing decree, board resolution, request letter and signature authorisation
Companies: trade licence, signature authorisation, memorandum of association for partnerships
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
